title: Fetch now result
description: One request against a polling source's vendor API, as shown by Fetch now. Producer: adapter-manager POST /poll-test (fetchResult in services/adapters/lib/poll.cjs), relayed by Laravel (PollingService::fetch) as the data of POST .../device-adapters/{adapter}/fetch-now. Consumers: the portal and the onboarding assistant. Delivery: one synchronous request and response, never retried and never queued; it does not move the cursor or publish anything, and Laravel keeps only a summary (time, ok, record count, error) in the adapter's health. Deduplication: none. Credentials are redacted from the headers, excerpt and records; set-cookie and authorization headers are dropped. A request that got no answer has status and duration_ms null and an error.

status.description: The vendor API's HTTP status; null when nothing answered.

excerpt.description: The start of the response body, up to 256 KiB of text.

record_count.description: Records found at the configured location.

items.description: One record as the vendor returned it.
